headline: This 2019 law requires the Department of Transportation to seek nominations for scenic byway designations and to publish a list of the roads it designates.
what_it_does: The law directs the Department of Transportation to issue a request for nominations of roads to be designated under the national scenic byways program. It also requires the department to make a list of the designated roads publicly available. The official summary does not describe the criteria for designation or any funding changes.

who_it_affects.group: State and local governments that manage roads
who_it_affects.how: They can be asked to nominate roads for the national scenic byways designation during the department's request for nominations.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the public, including travelers and tourism groups
who_it_affects.how: They can look up which roads have been designated as national scenic byways, because the department must publish the list.

when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on September 22, 2019. The summary does not list any later deadlines.
